name: Sbe - Varvit - Societa' Per Azioni
summary: Sbe - Varvit - Societa' Per Azioni manufactures and sells fasteners and mechanical fastening joints in Italy. It provides screws, nuts, and cold-pressed products for agricultural machinery, earth moving, industrial machinery, cranes, trucks, and trailers, as well as for wind, construction, and automotive sectors. The company also offers its products through online. In addition, it exports its products to approximately 70 countries. The company was incorporated in 2012 and is based in Reggio Emilia, Italy.
